authority: D-093: test whether the economic controller and its student deliver sustained conditional growth
selection: All 49 existing dev source games selected before this study; two explicit component endowments, not outcome-selected
future_rng: 11960000 + source_case_index * 100 + replica; paired across policies and variants
policy_intervention: Operator replaces actions only under the identical public two-core gate; ordinary evaluation guards and a single shared action counter remain active; no hidden RNG access
hypothesis: Whole-turn economic gains persist over subsequent turns and can be learned; first-turn body gains alone are insufficient
assessment: 588 conditional suffixes if all three fixed inputs are ready; source-clustered paired rank and common-survivor T9-T12 log growth, survivor median+n, spending and cap counts
execution_gate: CPU two-suffix native trace probe first; full run only after the fixed student checkpoint has been inspected; do not substitute an intermediate or best-selected student
limitations: Explicit endowed starts, not natural full-game performance
Heuristic uses its own action memory; student is feedforward
Conditional controller is not assumed optimal
No automatic expert labels from suffix outcomes
